name: 100 Princes Street
insider_take: This Georgian gem sits directly on Edinburgh's most prestigious shopping street, where royal history meets modern luxury in the shadow of Edinburgh Castle.
whats_special: The hotel occupies a stunning Georgian building from the 1800s and boasts one of Edinburgh's most coveted addresses - you're literally steps from the Scott Monument and overlooking Princes Street Gardens. The location puts you at the crossroads of the Old and New Towns, both UNESCO World Heritage Sites.
pro_tip: Book a room facing Princes Street Gardens for unobstructed views of Edinburgh Castle - it's especially magical during the Festival Fireworks in August.
dont_miss: Walk 2 minutes to climb the Scott Monument for panoramic city views, or head down the Royal Mile (5-minute walk) to explore closes and wynds dating back to medieval times. The famous Deacon's House Cafe in Brodie's Close serves breakfast in a building from 1490.
pros: Prime location on iconic Princes Street with Edinburgh Castle views
Walking distance to major attractions and shopping districts
Historic Victorian building with elegant period features
Excellent transport links and accessibility to Old Town
cons: Busy street location may experience urban noise
Limited parking availability in city center location
